metric_limitations: Contact forces are instantaneous MuJoCo contact-frame forces/torques, not PhysX per-step impulses.
Body/root velocities are world-oriented body-center-of-mass velocities from mj_objectVelocity(BODY).
Joint acceleration is qacc; acceleration_fd and root accelerations are 200 Hz backward differences.
joint_force is generalized actuator torque, not an equivalence claim with PhysX jointForce.
Body external wrenches use MuJoCo's subtree-CoM-centered spatial frame from cfrc_ext.
Policy/step timings are offline desktop CPU measurements; not headset performance.
synchronization: Initial state from PhysX. Initial standing inference at t0. Each n=1..4000: switch at n1000, inference before simulation when n%4==0, then .005s mj_step. mj_forward refreshes the completed state. Rows are post-step except t0; observation/action are last consumed/produced.
